oldSelves.rule: Each slot is built from one finished month of the owner's own data. Name: "AFC <Month Year>". Rating = that month's average radar mapped onto the tier bands; the slot sits in whichever tier that rating falls in. Each new season the newest finished month joins and the weakest Old Self retires to the Old Selves Cup.
oldSelves.crest: The month's initial over that month's best axis drawn as a single spoke.
oldSelves.colours: Taken from the month: the app's metric ink of that month's best axis plus night ink.

youthRules.intake: Once a season, in the break before it, three youngsters arrive, drawn from the pool. At most one exercise among the three.
youthRules.grow: Every day the habit is logged, the youngster gains form. 12 logged days in the season: promoted to the first team (it becomes a tracked squad member).
youthRules.leave: Fewer than 4 logged days by the season's end: they leave on a free. They may turn up later at a rival.
youthRules.bench: Off the bench at 60': if the habit was logged that day, their axis gets +2 for the rest of the match (from board 3).
youthRules.stars: Potential stars set how much they add once promoted: 3 stars +1 to their axis, 4 stars +1.5, 5 stars +2, on days the habit is done.
youthRules.safety: Exercise youngsters are gentle ones; anything new still goes past whoever looks after your training.

contracts.principle: One line on the squad list and one tap at renewal. Never more than that, so it never becomes the focus.
contracts.target: Each squad member signs with a plain target: the habit kept on at least 5 of 7 days on average.
contracts.renew: Hit the target: renew on more money, so their weight on your radar grows 5% (to a cap of +15% over a career).
contracts.run_down: Miss it: no penalty in matches. Their contract runs down and they are quietly transfer-listed; you can keep them on a new deal, sell, or let clubs bid.
contracts.trade: Selling a habit stops tracking it. Buyers pay in money, a youth slot or a staff member. Everything it did stays in history, and they may turn up against you later.
contracts.staff_not_players: Medicines are the physio and drinks are discipline (board 3): staff and rules, not contracted players.

sponsorRules.slots: Shirt front and kit maker from the start. A sleeve slot opens in Division Four. Stadium naming opens only once Brabo United own a ground. Up to three official partners at any time (small money, a line in the programme).
sponsorRules.offers: In each break, two or three offers arrive per open slot, from brands whose tier range covers yours. Tap one or wait (a better one may come mid-season, or nobody).
sponsorRules.deal: One to three seasons. Money per season comes from the tier table. Each offer carries one bonus clause: promotion, a cup run, clean sheets, or (at most one at a time) a light habit clause such as "+10% for every week Sleep hits target".
sponsorRules.risk: Stable brands pay the bottom of the range and stay. Flashy brands pay the middle and leave after a relegation. Dodgy brands pay the top and have a 1 in 4 chance a season of collapsing: the money stops, it leads the back page, and home crowds sulk for three matches (no home advantage).
sponsorRules.relegation: Stable sponsors stay through one relegation; others may walk.
sponsorRules.promotion: Promotion reopens every slot to bids at the new tier, but current deals run out first unless you buy them out.
sponsorRules.kit: The sponsor appears on the drawn kit as a wordmark in the app's style. Each season the kit maker offers two or three catalogue designs and you pick one.
sponsorRules.never: No betting and no alcohol brands are ever offered to Brabo United. Made-up brands stay made up; real brands are drawn as plain wordmarks, never logos.
sponsorRules.brabo_first_offers: Season 1 shirt offers: Frituur De Kaai (stable), Veerboot Linkeroever (stable), Fietskoerier Stad (stable, habit clause on steps). Kit maker: Strandloper or Ironside Teamwear.
sponsorRules.real_brands: From Division Three upward, real brands join the offers alongside the made-up ones: the real shirt sponsors and kit makers of the 40 real clubs (no betting firms). A real brand already on a rival’s shirt can still bid; landing one is a back-page story. Money follows the same tier table.
sponsorRules.your_own: At any time you can add a sponsor yourself: type any brand name, pick the slot, and it signs at the bottom of your tier’s range as a stable deal with no bonus clause. It replaces whoever held that slot when their deal ends, or straight away if the slot is empty.
